alignments.note: Presentative particle rendered Behold.
Temporal בְּ before an infinitive construct takes the when (rule 52).
Infinitive construct keeps the verb (rule 52).
Suffix on the infinitive is its subject and takes the subject pronoun (rule 18).
Predicate adjective rendered whole.
The ASV recasts the negation onto the object as no work, so the negative morpheme takes that no; the unit is discontinuous from the verb it negates (rule 25).
Niphal recast as it was meet, with its subject pronoun and copula (rule 17), headed on the word carrying the predication.
Preposition rendered for.
Noun rendered work; its determiner is the negative's no, aligned to s006.

The a fortiori particle אַף is rendered by the fixed three-word how much less, one rendering of which no morpheme owns a part (rule 30), headed on less as the word carrying the comparison. The competing reading fuses אַף and כִּי into that phrase and leaves when added; I keep them separate because כִּי has an English word of its own here.
כִּי takes the when the ASV writes for its clause (rules 14, 55).
Anarthrous noun with the ASV's supplied definite article, which belongs to the nominal expression (rule 15).
Finite verb with its auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.
Object suffix takes the object pronoun (rule 18).
Conjunction rendered and (rule 14).
Niphal with subject pronoun and copula, headed on burned.
The ASV opens the closing question with no connective, so this waw has nothing to take (rule 14).
Niphal with its auxiliary and subject pronoun, discontinuous around the adverb yet (rule 25), headed on meet.
Adverb עוֹד rendered yet.
Preposition rendered for.
The supplied determiner any belongs to the noun it determines (rule 15); the competing reading marks it added under rule 30.

review_notes: אַף כִּי is split rather than fused, because the ASV writes how much less for אַף and a separate when for כִּי, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own and rule 2 applies; the competing fusion reading is recorded in the אַף unit.
The negative לֹא takes the no of no work rather than being marked unrepresented, since that is where the ASV's recasting puts the negation.
